decision.summary: The Federal Reserve decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent.

changes.quote: Following sharp declines, economic activity and employment have picked up somewhat in recent months but remain well below their levels at the beginning of the year.
changes.explanation: The Fed acknowledges that the economy has rebounded slightly from its initial steep drop, but activity and jobs are still far below where they started the year.

changes.quote: The path of the economy will depend significantly on the course of the virus.
changes.explanation: This new addition emphasizes that future economic recovery is directly tied to how the coronavirus pandemic unfolds.

tone_quotes.quote: The coronavirus outbreak is causing tremendous human and economic hardship across the United States and around the world.
The ongoing public health crisis will weigh heavily on economic activity, employment, and inflation in the near term, and poses considerable risks to the economic outlook over the medium term.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 15.09% APR costs about $62.88 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 0.58% and moved -1 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 2.98% would fall by about $1.62 a month.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 11%, and employers added an average of -4,408k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 0.7% over the past year (June 2020); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 1%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a -28% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved -2 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved 1.24%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved -0.09% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that the Federal Reserve will maintain its current loose monetary policy stance until it is confident the economy has weathered recent events.

citations.detail: In light of these developments, the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent.

validation_notes: Forecast probabilities removed from whats_next (the page shows the live computed forecast).
